components.name: Copy Install Bar
components.description: Terminal command copy box with inline action trigger.
components.html: $npx dbtools-cli status
components.css: .ds-install-box { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #030712; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); border-radius: 10px; padding: 6px 6px 6px 16px; gap: 14px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.95rem; } .ds-prompt { color: #06b6d4; } .ds-cmd { color: #93c5fd; } .ds-copy-btn { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); color: #f9fafb; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.85rem; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-copy-btn:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16); }

components.html:

narrative.overview: dbtools visual language embodies precision, immutability, and deterministic technical authority. Engineered for developers, platform teams, and autonomous AI agents, the interface draws aesthetic inspiration from mission-critical control panels and cryptographic hardware: deep obsidian surfaces, razor-sharp hairline borders, high-legibility typography, and focused neon telemetry signals.
keyCharacteristics: Obsidian & Telemetry: Deep dark canvas punctuated by electric blue focal points, cyan telemetry accents, and emerald ledger verifications.
Hairline Precision: 1px subtle boundary strokes (rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)) that highlight on active focus or hover (rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4)).
Dual-Layer Typography: High-contrast geometric sans (Inter) for crisp structural hierarchy paired with monospaced code blocks (JetBrains Mono) for logs, CLI commands, and cryptographic hashes.

rules.name: The Telemetry Purpose Rule
rules.body: Accent colors are strictly semantic and never decorative filler. Blue signals navigation/action, Cyan signals prompt/telemetry, Emerald signals immutable cryptographic truth, and Amber signals protected execution boundaries.

rules.name: The Code Is Truth Rule
rules.body: Any value representing a command, file name, environment variable, version number, or cryptographic hash must be typeset in monospace font.

rules.name: The Ambient Depth Rule
rules.body: Depth is created through translucent glassmorphism (backdrop-filter: blur(10px)) and subtle border luminescence rather than aggressive solid shadows.

dos: Do format all commands, flags, migration versions, and cryptographic hashes in JetBrains Mono.
Do preserve the 1px hairline border structure (rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)) across all surfaces and cards.
Do use Emerald (#10b981) exclusively for verified/clean statuses and Amber (#f59e0b) for warnings/protections.
Do maintain high visual contrast ratios (> 7:1) between text and dark surfaces for maximum technical readability.
donts: Don't use solid bright white or generic gray backgrounds; keep the canvas grounded in Obsidian Black (#0b0f19).
Don't apply heavy drop shadows or skeumorphic bevels to buttons or cards.
Don't mix unstyled serif fonts or decorative display scripts into technical surfaces.
Don't clutter interfaces with unmetered accent colors; preserve the calm, high-contrast control room aesthetic.
